description: Routing evals for Level 1/2/3 fractal schema semantics, ripple checks, and current-state contract maintenance.

cases.prompt: I changed a module's exported behavior and moved one dependency into a shared adapter. Update the fractal header and any affected AGENTS.md semantics.
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and update Level 3 contract semantics first, then ripple upward only if ownership or topology semantics changed.
expectations: Uses the packaged fractal-scope checker before writing Level 3 or Level 2 artifacts
Uses Level 3 INPUT/OUTPUT/ROLE semantics
Checks whether folder or root contracts actually changed before updating them
Avoids turning headers into change logs

cases.prompt: Create a new folder manifest for this bounded context and keep it aligned with the canonical Scope, Constraints, and Members schema.
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill only if the request is schema-semantics focused; if the manifest content must be inferred from code, prefer fractal-agents-fill and use this skill as schema reference.
expectations: Uses the packaged fractal-scope checker before normalizing an existing manifest
Uses Scope, Constraints, and Members
Does not steal directory contract fill work from fractal-agents-fill
Keeps current state separate from history
Avoids unnecessary Dependencies or Review Triggers sections

cases.prompt: Restructure the docs tree, rename several postmortem files, and fix the repo index links.
cases.expected_output: Should prefer fractal-repo, not this skill, because the work is about repository placement, naming, and indexing rather than schema semantics.
expectations: Should not route primarily to fractal-context
Recognizes repo topology vs schema boundary

cases.prompt: This bugfix needs a reusable root-cause writeup with verification and prevention notes.
cases.expected_output: Should prefer postmortem, not this skill, unless code changes also require fractal header updates.
expectations: Does not confuse postmortem generation with fractal schema maintenance

cases.prompt: A file still has legacy UPDATE log lines in its header. Normalize it to the current fractal contract.
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and convert legacy historical header behavior into current-state fields.
expectations: Removes append-only UPDATE log behavior
Normalizes to canonical fields

cases.prompt: Write a decision record explaining why we switched auth providers.
cases.expected_output: Should not load this skill unless the task also changes Level 1/2/3 schema semantics; this is mainly a repository document placement problem.
expectations: Should prefer fractal-repo for decision-doc placement

cases.prompt: The folder has no AGENTS.md yet. Read the code and write one that explains what the directory owns.
cases.expected_output: Should prefer fractal-agents-fill, not this skill, because the task is local contract capture from code rather than schema authority.
expectations: Does not steal missing-manifest fill work
Routes schema-only support to fractal-context and content inference to fractal-agents-fill

cases.prompt: Define the root AGENTS.md traversal rules so agents know which subtree to read before opening code.
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and use the Level 1 Traversal contract as the canonical schema rule.
expectations: Includes Local Maps first traversal
Requires reading the target subtree AGENTS.md before code
Includes decision freshness check before architecture changes

cases.prompt: Add a glossary term to this bounded context without creating CONTEXT.md.
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill for schema semantics and point to Level 2 Language as manual-only glossary authority.
expectations: Uses Level 2 Language
Treats Language as manual-only intent
Does not create CONTEXT.md

cases.prompt: Should we enable L3 headers for every source file in the repo?
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and recommend enabling L3 only for non-obvious contract files, not blanket coverage.
expectations: Mentions FFI, serialization, state machines, concurrency invariants, public APIs, or cross-module protocols
States L3 is a source-file header
Rejects blanket enablement
